title: Trove medical condition
description: One line of health/medical/<source>/conditions/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a problem, diagnosis, or condition (FHIR Condition, or an ICD-10 diagnosis carried on a Blue Button claim). Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local recorded date, or a date-only YYYY-MM-DD when that is all the source gives

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key: FHIR Condition.id, or eob-id+dx-seq

code_system.description: which system the code is from: "snomed" | "icd10" | …

onset.description: onset (RFC3339 local, date-only, or a coarse year "2019" when that's all that's recorded)

extra.description: everything source-specific (verification status, severity, full resource)
